month_summary: August 1914 witnessed the opening campaigns of the Great War across multiple continents. The German invasion of Belgium and France initially succeeded, with fortresses falling and French offensives collapsing in the 'Battle of the Frontiers.' The British Expeditionary Force fought its first battles at Mons and Le Cateau before joining the general Allied retreat. Meanwhile, the war spread globally as colonial empires mobilized, with fighting erupting in Africa and Asia. Political unity emerged in all nations through 'Sacred Unions' and 'Burgfriedenspolitik' as populations rallied behind their flags. The month ended with German forces approaching Paris and the Allies in full retreat, setting the stage for the crucial Battle of the Marne.
